```{r}
actual_data <- read.csv("crypto_data/10_dropped_variables_and_renamed.csv")
```

```{r}
coin_expanding_window_predict <- actual_data %>%
  group_by(coin) %>%
  mutate(week = dmy(week)) %>%
  arrange(week) %>% 
  filter(week > as.Date("2018-01-01")) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Calculate expanding mean (average of all data up to t-1)
    # We use lag() because at week T, you can only know the mean of weeks 1 to T-1
    expanding_mean_y_1 = (cummean(ret_1w_ago))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(expanding_mean_y = slider::slide_dbl(ret_1w_ago, mean, .before = 200, .after = 0)) %>%
  # Your specific OOS test period
  filter(week <= as.Date("2026-01-08"))

# View result
bch <- coin_expanding_window_predict %>%
  filter(coin == "BCH")

```

```{r}
calculate_r_square <- function(pred, actual, mean){
  1 - ((sum((actual - pred)^2)) / (sum((actual - mean)^2)))
}

calculate_rmse <- function(pred, actual){
  sqrt(sum((actual-pred)^2))
}
```

## Arima
```{r}
arima_data <- read.csv("Predictions/arima_forecast_residuals.csv")

unique_coins <- arima_data$coin %>%
  unique()


all_r_squared <- list()

for (i in unique_coins){
  
  coin_data <- arima_data %>%
    filter(coin == i) %>%
    mutate(week = ymd(week))
  
  rolling_data <- coin_expanding_window_predict %>%
    filter(coin == i) %>%
    select(week, expanding_mean_y)
  
  merged <- coin_data %>%
    left_join(rolling_data, by = c("week" = "week"))
  
  r_squared_temp <- calculate_r_square(
    merged$prediction,
    merged$actual, 
    merged$expanding_mean_y
  )
  
  
  all_r_squared[["arima"]][[i]] <- r_squared_temp
}

merged_all <- arima_data %>%
  mutate(week = ymd(week)) %>%
  left_join(coin_expanding_window_predict, by = c("coin", "week"))

r_squared_temp <- calculate_r_square(
    merged_all$prediction,
    merged_all$actual, 
    merged_all$expanding_mean_y)

all_r_squared[['arima']][['all']] <- r_squared_temp 
```

## PLS
```{r}

files <- list.files("Predictions/predictions", pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
data_list <- lapply(files, read_excel)

pls_data <- data.frame()
for (i in 1: length(data_list)){
   
  coin_data <- data_list[[i]] %>%
    mutate(week = ymd(week)) 
  
  pls_data <- rbind(coin_data, pls_data)

}

for (i in 1: length(data_list)){
   
  coin_data <- data_list[[i]] %>%
    mutate(week = ymd(week)) 
  
  coin_curr <- data_list[[i]]$coin[1]
  
  
  rolling_data <- coin_expanding_window_predict %>%
    filter(coin == coin_curr) %>%
    select(week, expanding_mean_y) 
  
  merged <- coin_data %>%
    left_join(rolling_data, by = c("week" = "week"))
  
   r_squared_temp <- calculate_r_square(
    merged$pred,
    merged$actual, 
    merged$expanding_mean_y
  )
   
   
   
   all_r_squared[["pls"]][[coin_curr]] <- r_squared_temp

}

merged_all <- pls_data %>%
  left_join(coin_expanding_window_predict, by = c("coin", "week"))

r_squared_temp <- calculate_r_square(
    merged_all$pred,
    merged_all$actual, 
    merged_all$expanding_mean_y)

all_r_squared[['pls']][['all']] <- r_squared_temp 
```

```{r}
df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(all_r_squared), function(model) {
    data.frame(
      coin = names(all_r_squared[[model]]),
      r_squared = unlist(all_r_squared[[model]]),
      model = model
    )
  })
) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = r_squared)
```

```{r}

```


```{r}
write.csv(df, "df_r_squared.csv")
```


```{r}
arima_data <- read.csv("Predictions/arima_forecast_residuals.csv")

unique_coins <- arima_data$coin %>%
  unique()


rmse_all <- list()

for (i in unique_coins){
  data_temp <- arima_data %>%
    filter(coin == i)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((data_temp$actual - data_temp$prediction)^2))
  
  rmse_all[["arima"]][[i]] <- rmse
}

rmse_temp <- sqrt(mean((arima_data$actual - arima_data$prediction)^2))
rmse_all[["arima"]][["all"]] <- rmse_temp
```

## PLS
```{r}

files <- list.files("Predictions/predictions", pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)

pls_data <- data.frame()
for (i in 1: length(data_list)){
```
